band_confound.columns: native annotation columns; classes 1-4 are BAE, EAE, RSAE, TAE

campaign_overlap.block: shot // 100 (shots of one run day sit in a block or two)

rule.applies_to: every ae-ours record of every arm and seed, uniformly

screen.scope: selected checkpoint, selection shots, its own activity target
screen.sd_statistic: mean over selection shots of the population SD of the score
screen.statement: A record whose selected checkpoint is constant (within-shot SD below 0.005) or does not rank its own target above chance (selection AUROC at most 0.5) is excluded and replaced by the arm's next unused seed, starting at 3, which is trained under the same training rule and screened again.

training.conformance: A record conforms when replaying this rule on its recorded selection-loss history stops it at the recorded final epoch; a record that stopped earlier is rerun with the same seed.
training.monitor: combined loss on the 20 selection shots
training.statement: Early stopping counts non-improving epochs only from zero-based epoch 10, so a plateau in the first ten epochs cannot end a run.

ae-ours-dense-seed1-superseded1.status: superseded: rerun with the same seed

ae-ours-legacy-seed2-superseded1.status: superseded: rerun with the same seed

dense_history.interval_changing_saves: saves whose window or intervals differ from the shot's previous save
dense_history.login_meaning: the login of the review server's process, not the person

plan.status: superseded: rerun with the same seed
superseded: rerun with the same seed

limitations: Older detectors have no saved predictions for 41/60 evaluation shots.
Older calibration uses only the six selection shots they did not train on.
Three seeds per arm give limited precision for training variability.
Runs used A100 (legacy and dense seed 0) and V100S GPUs; a V100-only sensitivity analysis is recorded.
precision: scores are float32 (autocast off) re-inferences of the checkpoints (infer-fp32); precision_check compares them with the first, bfloat16 inference

precision_check.statistic: pooled-frame AUROC and AUPRC of each run, fp32 minus bf16

protocol.dense: catalog any-touch; only present/absent frames scored
protocol.legacy: audit: >= half annotated columns; classes 1-4, LFM excluded
protocol.recipe: ae_train defaults: SCE, 710 frames, 8 windows/shot, batch 16, 30 epochs, AdamW 1e-4, weight decay 1e-4, cosine min lr 1e-6
protocol.selection: minimum own-target loss on 20 selection shots, patience 5
protocol.threeway: original native annotation AND TokEye; disagreement ignored
protocol.threshold: maximum 10 ms selection F1 for own activity target

bootstrap.pairing: identical shot draws and seed indices across arms
